assumptions.statement: Official regulatory controls, heritage zones, road redlines, parcels, utilities, fire/emergency constraints, existing buildings, access controls, current AED points, service hours and retrieval routes are unavailable in the public package.
assumptions.impact: Spatial and construction content remains conceptual; no statutory, ownership, demolition, or engineering conclusion may be made.

assumptions.statement: The site and three key-area polygons are rough repository geometry inferred from public descriptions and approximate areas. Reproducible community checks in repository Issue #1029 report that provisional PROV-KEY-003 is internally area/order-consistent but centred near Beijing North Station, about 2.26 km from Dazhongsi metro; this is not an official replacement boundary or permission to shift it.
assumptions.impact: The package keeps upstream geometry only as a placeholder and treats Dazhongsi as the programme name from the brief, not a verified map anchor. All real sites require separate verification; canonical or official geometry must trigger whole-package recalculation.

assumptions.statement: No current AED asset, cabinet, service hour, access path, inspection result, five-minute result or named Dazhongsi partner is assumed from citywide public information.
assumptions.impact: Every current point and state must be verified by its asset/site responsibility unit and field audit before it appears as a pilot fact.

assumptions.statement: No asset owner, installation unit, site operator, inspection role, 120 liaison, training partner or post-use restoration role is assumed to have committed.
assumptions.impact: A real pilot cannot start until responsibilities, service windows, escalation, alternative-point and restoration duties are confirmed in writing.

assumptions.statement: AI does not diagnose cardiac arrest, interpret rhythm, decide whether to shock, instruct a user against 120 or device voice guidance, or replace professional emergency care.
assumptions.impact: AI may identify stale/conflicting readiness records and summarise drills only; medical action remains with the device, 120, responders and applicable professional system.

assumptions.statement: The minimum event model contains no patient, bystander or trainee name, phone, identity, face, voice, health record, exact personal route, employer or continuous trajectory field.
assumptions.impact: Discovery of such a field is a stop condition; drills use role codes, aggregate time bands and training equipment, with no real patient event in the MVP.

assumptions.statement: The Five-Minute Readiness Station, Phone-free Retrieval Classroom, Readiness Protocol Test Bench and simulated incident point are study nodes, not confirmed sites or AED locations.
assumptions.impact: Field survey, asset/site consent, emergency-professional review, access, fire, accessibility, crowd and evacuation checks are required before siting.

assumptions.statement: The 90-day schedule, service windows, drill origins, five-minute threshold, restoration target and continuation rules are proposed for joint confirmation.
assumptions.impact: The pilot may shrink, pause or stop if responsibility, access, equipment, emergency-professional, privacy, labour or safety gates are not met.

assumptions.statement: All first-stage retrieval and restoration drills use training AEDs or inert props, simulated incident cards and authorised routes; they are not clinical research.
assumptions.impact: No real patient, shock or health record is introduced; failures, human handover and repeatability can still be measured safely.

assumptions.statement: The public may retrieve and use a public AED under device and 120 guidance; training status must not become a lock, scan, membership or professionals-only access gate.
assumptions.impact: Site staff support access and call 120 but do not invent medical instructions or override the device; public access remains free and fast where the point is declared open.

assumptions.statement: A point is green only when all eight readiness conditions are currently evidenced; map presence alone never proves readiness.
assumptions.impact: Any expired, missing or conflicting condition forces a degraded/closed state and an explicit verified alternative rather than optimistic inference.

assumptions.statement: DB11/T 2564-2026 was issued on 2026-06-30 and takes effect on 2026-10-01, after this proposal date.
assumptions.impact: Its five-minute, service-hour, responsibility and record provisions are implementation-ready references, not current-effect legal claims or evidence of site compliance.
